compatibility.name: Habitat Challenge 2020 PointNav
compatibility.success_criteria: Issue STOP within success radius of the relative goal (Habitat used 0.36 m for LoCoBot-sized agent).
blockers: No Habitat-Sim / Gibson dataset integration
No RGB-D observation stream in Parcel runtime
GPS-free visual localization not implemented (Habitat 2020 PointNav removes GPS+compass)
Embodiment and action noise model differ from LoCoBot
compatibility.parcel_bridge: Map relative goal → NavObservation + GoalPose; mid-level vx/vy/vyaw; score with metrics.spl using Euclidean or grid shortest path.
compatibility.recommendation: Use offline PointNav proxy for formula regression. Pursue Habitat only if adding a visual stack is an explicit product goal.

compatibility.name: Habitat Challenge 2020 ObjectNav
compatibility.success_criteria: STOP within 1.0 m of any target-category instance with oracle visibility from the stop pose (turn/look allowed, no translation).
blockers: No Matterport3D scenes
No RGB-D category recognition pipeline
Sim semantic polygons are diagnostics_only, not production perception
compatibility.parcel_bridge: SemanticGoal + ObservationSemanticMap / synthetic labeled objects; SPL to closest instance from start.
compatibility.recommendation: Offline ObjectNav proxy is useful for goal-verification logic. Do not report Habitat ObjectNav numbers from sim-truth labels alone.

compatibility.name: BARN / BARN Challenge (metric ground navigation)
compatibility.success_criteria: Reach goal with zero collisions; score uses OT/AT clip formula from BARN Challenge.
blockers: The pinned source works in a cache-only Bubblewrap/PRoot diagnostic rootfs, but the upstream-tested SingularityCE/SIF path remains unavailable
Parcel's content-addressed world-0 hook is classified policy_no_translation before the evaluator starts a trial
An official result requires organizer-attested 50-hidden-world x 10-trial execution
The 2026 deadline has passed and post-event organizer evaluation is not confirmed
Go2 footprint and max speed differ from the standardized Jackal 2 m/s protocol
compatibility.parcel_bridge: Synthetic narrow corridors + cylinder clutter; LiDAR/proximity extras; BARN score with Go2 vmax from robot.yaml.
compatibility.recommendation: Use the pinned ROS 2 Jazzy Singularity route for public compatibility and keep the native sensor-only runner for fast regression. Never promote either to an official score without the organizer's hidden evaluation and attestation.

compatibility.name: 3WE standardized embodied benchmarks
compatibility.success_criteria: PointNav/ObjectNav: SR + SPL over ≥100 episodes for official submits; Exploration: coverage within time budget + efficiency.
blockers: Pinned runner has no immutable external-agent observation/action hook
Seed/reset/timeouts, PointNav success/SPL, ObjectNav, and Exploration semantics conflict with documentation
Isaac is a no-op stub and the office pose/world/bridge coordinate contract is inconsistent
Documented, runner, validator, and static leaderboard schemas/results diverge
Shipped simulator is a holonomic mecanum robot, not a Unitree Go2
No backend-specific cohort is large or authoritative enough to freeze a percentile
compatibility.parcel_bridge: Mirror only generic task shapes and metric formulas in explicitly synthetic, rank-ineligible local tests; no adapter is admitted against the audited revision.
compatibility.recommendation: Keep all three targets unresolved. Wait for an organizer-confirmed, task-correct, backend-specific evaluator with a neutral agent hook before building an adapter.

compatibility.name: Social-HM3D / Falcon SocialNav
compatibility.success_criteria: Reach goal while measuring human collisions and personal-space compliance.
blockers: Requires Habitat + HM3D/MP3D + ORCA humanoids
Parcel living city uses seeded routes, not full reciprocal ORCA crowds
compatibility.parcel_bridge: Synthetic pedestrians in kinematic episodes; reuse proximity thresholds aligned with Parcel safety config.
compatibility.recommendation: Use offline SocialNav metrics beside the MuJoCo living-city harness. Official Social-HM3D remains a research-only dependency.
